---
title: "R Notebook"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_notebook: default
---

```{r table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)

my_data <- array(rnorm(12), dim=c(3,4))
rownames(my_data) <- c("Ursula","Victor","Wilma")
colnames(my_data) <- c("A", "B", "C", "D")

kbl(my_data, caption="Some titie...", booktabs = T) %>%
 kable_paper(full_width=F) %>%
 add_header_above(c("Names" = 1, "Good" = 2, "Bad"=2))
```
